description: Structured medical note extracted from a recorded clinician-patient phone call. Base every value on what was actually said; use null (or an empty list) when the call does not cover a field.

chief_complaint.description: The primary reason for the call in the patient's own terms, stated concisely (e.g. "shortness of breath and persistent cough").

symptoms.description: Every symptom the patient reports, one entry each, including duration/severity/triggers when mentioned (e.g. "dry cough for 4 months"). Only symptoms the patient confirms — not ones the clinician asked about and the patient denied.

relevant_history.description: Medical and social history relevant to the complaint: prior diagnoses, smoking/alcohol use, occupational or environmental exposures, family history. A few sentences of prose.

medications_discussed.description: Medications mentioned on the call — current, past, or newly considered — with dose and status when stated (e.g. "albuterol inhaler, newly prescribed"). Empty if none come up.

assessment.description: The clinician's working impression or differential as voiced on the call, including what they want to rule out. Do not infer a diagnosis the clinician never states.

plan.description: Agreed next steps: tests or imaging ordered, referrals, prescriptions, lifestyle advice.

follow_up.description: When and how the patient will be seen or contacted next (e.g. "clinic visit after CT results, ~2 weeks"). Null if no follow-up is arranged.
